title: Preparing Artifacts and Configuration

header.html: Manage dependencies for code modules within packages (3.1.1); build and manage container images (3.1.2); use code repositories in deployment environments (3.1.3); manage environment-specific application configuration (3.1.4); use API Gateway features and resources such as stage-specific URLs and endpoints (3.1.5)
the official AWS Developer Associate (DVA-C03) exam guide, Task 3.1

html:
1Packaging code

Artifact Details
Lambda zip Code plus dependencies in a .zip; layers share common dependencies
Lambda container image Up to 10 GB, built from a Dockerfile, stored in Amazon ECR
Application bundle For EC2 or on-premises deploys, a bundle with an AppSpec file (Module 13)
Dependencies Pin versions, package them with the code, keep the package small to deploy and start faster

2Container images and Amazon ECR

Concept Meaning
Dockerfile The recipe that builds the image
Amazon ECR Managed container registry
Image tag A label such as v1.4 or prod; immutable tags stop overwriting
Lifecycle policy Rules that expire old or untagged images to save space
Image scanning Finds known vulnerabilities in images
Authentication Get a token with aws ecr get-login-password, then docker login and docker push
Exam tip

. "Remove untagged and old images automatically" = ECR lifecycle policy. "Do not allow a tag to be overwritten" = immutable tags.

3Code repositories

Deployments pull code from a version-controlled repository (for example GitHub or another Git service); CodePipeline and CodeBuild can start from repository events. Use branches for environments and tags for releases (Module 13).

4Environment-specific configuration

Tool Best for
AWS AppConfig Feature flags and runtime configuration with validation and gradual rollout with rollback
Systems Manager Parameter Store Configuration values and simple secrets, organized by path (for example /app/prod/db)
AWS Secrets Manager Secrets with rotation
Lambda environment variables Small, non-secret settings per function or alias
API Gateway stage variables Values per stage (for example the Lambda alias to call)
Exam tip

. Change a setting without redeploying, roll it out gradually = AppConfig. Keep one codebase and vary the settings per environment.

5API Gateway stages and endpoints

Feature Meaning
Stage A named deployment of an API (dev, test, prod); each has its own URL (.../dev, .../prod)
Stage variables Per-stage settings
Canary release Send a percentage of traffic to a new deployment on a stage
Custom domain name Map your own domain to an API stage
Endpoint types Edge-optimized, Regional, Private (inside a VPC)
Exam tip

. One codebase, many environments: stages, aliases and per-environment parameters, not copies of the code.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Old and untagged container images are filling an ECR repository. What should the team add?

  • AA larger Dockerfile
  • BA lifecycle policy
  • CAn S3 bucket
  • DA VPC endpoint
Show the answer

Answer: B. Lifecycle policies expire images automatically.

S2A team wants feature flags that can be changed without redeploying and rolled out gradually. Which service fits?

  • AAmazon SQS
  • BAWS KMS
  • CAmazon Route 53
  • DAWS AppConfig
Show the answer

Answer: D. AppConfig supports validated, gradual configuration rollouts.

S3A developer wants each environment of an API to have its own URL. What should be used?

  • ASeparate AWS accounts only
  • BLambda layers
  • CAPI Gateway stages
  • DDynamoDB tables
Show the answer

Answer: C. Each stage has its own invoke URL.

S4A Lambda function needs a large machine-learning library of 3 GB. What is the right packaging?

  • AA zip file
  • BA container image
  • CAn environment variable
  • DA layer of 3 GB
Show the answer

Answer: B. Container images allow up to 10 GB; zip packages are much smaller.

S5Configuration values for dev, test and prod should share one codebase. Where can the values live?

  • AHard-coded constants
  • BSeparate source branches for each value
  • CA public file
  • DParameter Store paths per environment
Show the answer

Answer: D. Path-organized parameters let one codebase read per-environment settings.

S6A team does not want an image tag overwritten after release. What should be enabled?

  • AImage scanning only
  • BLong polling
  • CImmutable tags
  • DProvisioned concurrency
Show the answer

Answer: C. Immutable tags prevent overwriting an existing tag.

6.2 Recall questions

R1What is the maximum Lambda container image size?

Show the answer

10 GB.

R2Which registry stores container images on AWS?

Show the answer

Amazon ECR.

R3What does a stage variable hold?

Show the answer

A per-stage setting for an API.

R4Which tool offers validation and gradual rollout of configuration?

Show the answer

AWS AppConfig.

R5Name two secret or configuration stores.

Show the answer

Secrets Manager and Parameter Store.

R6What does an ECR image scan find?

Show the answer

Known vulnerabilities in the image.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Packages zip + layers; container image up to 10 GB in ECR
ECR tags, immutable tags, lifecycle policies, scanning
Config AppConfig (flags, rollout), Parameter Store, Secrets Manager, env vars
API Gateway stages with own URLs, stage variables, canary, custom domains
